deckMethod: Deck built in fixed order (Common 5 designs x 800, Rare 5 x 500, Epic 5 x 200, Legendary design 1-277), then shuffled with Python random.Random(0x544859524b).shuffle() — a Fisher-Yates shuffle driven by the Mersenne Twister PRNG. Token ID = deck position + 1. Edition numbers are assigned per design in deck order (first occurrence = edition 1). Re-running generate_metadata.py reproduces the exact same deck.
deckHashEncoding: Per token in deck order (token ID 1 first), 3 bytes: byte 0 = rarity code (0=Common, 1=Rare, 2=Epic, 3=Legendary); bytes 1-2 = design index as big-endian uint16 (Common/Rare/Epic: 1-5; Legendary: 1-277). Concatenate all 7,777 x 3 = 23,331 bytes and take keccak256. keccak256 from eth-hash (pip install "eth-hash[pycryptodome]"), fallback Crypto.Hash.keccak.

files.metadata: metadata/1.json .. 7777.json (mintable) + metadata/divine-1.json .. divine-77.json (Divine, token-only redeem, not in the mint deck)
files.sources: legendary-traits.json (Legendary traits), divine-batch-D1.json .. D4.json (Divine 016-077 traits), EXISTING-FILES.md (Divine 001-015 source names)

notes: Divine is NOT part of the mint deck and NOT part of deckHash; Divine is redeemable only with 1,500 $THYRK (1 of 77).
Legendary 1-7 are the approved originals; their traits in metadata are assigned from their source-file names in generate_metadata.py (LEGENDARY_ORIGINALS).
Divine 001-015 traits are derived from their approved source-file names in EXISTING-FILES.md (generate_metadata.py DIVINE_FIRST_15).
All images are 1600x1600 WebP pixel art.
